<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 224.120 corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 223.112 Da. Matching this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈ 17 % M+1, ≈ 1.6 % M+2) points to a formula with 16 carbons (≈ 17 % M+1 from 13C) and a single oxygen. The exact mass for C₁₆H₁₅O is 223.11229 Da, which fits the measured mass within < 1 mDa. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₆H₁₅O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H15O</final_answer>
